title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B Logits Schedule Introspection
command: Monkey-patch dae_app, build Qwen3-1.7B one-layer logits instructions with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, QWEN1P7B_NO_PREFETCH=all, QWEN1P7B_LOGITS_SPLIT_M=6, and dump selected SM instruction windows without calling launch_dae.
observation: The build-only probe materialized the co-located logits schedule without launching. Qwen logits use 3 epochs with logits_slice=50688 for vocab_size=151936, active_tokens=8, hidden=2048, and split_M=6. The first direct logits GEMV descriptors are desc32 loadA, desc33 loadB, and desc34 storeC by GemvLayer construction order. SM64's logits-era PC window maps desc33 at pc38/43/50, desc32 repeated loads at pc39-47 and pc51-54, and desc34 stores at pc48/55; this matches the prior failing launch log's desc_idx=33/32/34 sequence.
blocker: VDCores still cannot import queue/resource-policy timing: the illegal instruction is now localized to the direct logits GEMV instruction window after final_rms, and the next diagnostic must inspect VDCores memory-slot allocation and RepeatM loop handling for the desc32/33/34 direct TMA sequence.

rules_out: missing schedule materialization as the cause of the logits-stage failure
argmax or restore scheduling as the first source of the desc32/33/34 failure sequence
summary.next_debug_target: inspect VDCores memory-slot allocation and RepeatM loop handling for the direct logits GEMV desc32/33/34 instruction window before attempting resource-policy timing
